description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {0} due to Fluctuator and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol, Slogurk's first triggered ability, and Surly Badgersaur trigger.
Resolve Surly Badgersaur's ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding (1).
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Slogurk.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, its last ability triggers, returning the cycled land and up to two additional land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Slogurk's ability from step 2, failing to put a counter on Slogurk since it has left the battlefield.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
